Read `/AGENTS.md` and follow it as the authoritative repository contract. Follow the procedures in `/skills/*/SKILL.md`. Prefer composing existing provider-native modules. Never add credentials, never run `terraform destroy`, `terraform apply -auto-approve`, `terraform apply` without a saved plan file, or `terraform state` write commands. Check shell commands with `python3 scripts/guard-terraform.py -- <command>` (exit 2 = blocked).
